verdict.rationale: Sill says there is no account and no server: screen content and keystrokes travel only between your own devices, so data stays wherever your hardware is. Remote use runs through your own VPN (such as Tailscale) or a port you forward, rather than a vendor relay. Residency is guaranteed by the local-only architecture, not by a region selector. missing for 10: an explicit data-residency statement or region-choice documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-server claim.
